item.retrocosmos.venusian_idol.lore: A squat jade god with golden eyes. It feels warm.
item.retrocosmos.sun_disk_fragment.lore: Hammered gold from a shattered sun disc.
item.retrocosmos.ancient_amulet.lore: Turquoise set in gold. Its eye seems to follow you.
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_0: "...and the Sun went down into the Sea of Steam, and did not rise again." - H.C.
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_1: "Count of the priest-kings: forty and seven. The last has no name." - H.C.
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_2: "Feed the great lizards at the gate, lest they enter." (?)
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_3: "Our ships of fire went up to the Blue Star and found it empty." Earth?!
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_4: A star map. Venus, the Sun... and a third circle, crossed out.
item.retrocosmos.glyph_tablet.lore_5: "Here sleeps the Keeper of the Seven Suns. Do not wake him."
book.retrocosmos.expedition_log.page_0: Venus Expedition No. 2, 1957. Day 41. The ruins are older than anything on Earth. Brennan swears the glyphs move when you are not looking at them.
book.retrocosmos.expedition_log.page_1: Day 44. Found the stair under the sanctuary floor. The air below is dry and cold. We left a canister of fuel at the landing for the trip back.
book.retrocosmos.expedition_log.page_2: Day 47. Kowalski stepped on a plate in the tomb doorway. Darts. He'll live. MIND THE THRESHOLD.
book.retrocosmos.expedition_log.page_3: Day 52. The big lizards are circling the camp. Rocket fuel low. If anyone finds this - the ziggurat to the east holds the rest of our supplies. God speed. - Dr. H. Calloway
book.retrocosmos.expedition_log.title: Expedition Log

book.retrocosmos.oinstein_journal.page_0: LAB JOURNAL - Dr. A. Oinstein. Day 1 on Venus. The hominids of this jungle are a gift: strong backs, nimble hands, and minds as empty as a fresh notebook. I shall fill them.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_journal.page_1: Day 112. Specimen 14 survived the serum. Twice the muscle, half the patience. I name the type HOMINID NOVUS. It obeys whoever holds the whistle. I hold the whistle.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_journal.page_2: Day 260. Brain-flask grafts at last! Specimen 31 recited the periodic table and then shot an assistant. A success. HOMINUS SAPIENS walks. A better ape for a better tomorrow!
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_journal.page_3: Day 301. The Earth expedition is snooping around the ruins. The barrier stays up. Nobody enters the lower laboratory. NOBODY. Not even you, Kessler - I know you read this.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_orders.page_0: STANDING ORDERS. 1. Capture hominids alive. Damaged specimens are deducted from your rations.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_orders.page_1: 2. Sentries hold their posts. Automatons patrol. Novus units do not eat the specimens. 3. Laser barriers stay ON. Touching them is a firing offence. Literally.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_orders.page_2: 4. Visitors from Earth are to be welcomed warmly - into Cage 3. Glory to science! - Dr. A. Oinstein, Director, Oinstein Institute.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page_0: Field notes, outpost 7. Serum batch V-9: three Novus, one fatality, one tail (?). The doctor is pleased.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page_1: Relay pylons must stay powered - the Institute barrier draws on all of them. If a pylon goes dark, run.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_clearance.page: SECURITY OFFICE - MEMO 12. Clearance for the Institute is by punched card only. Readers stand beside every barrier. One card per level; cards are NOT to be copied, lent or eaten.

LEVEL A (red): the main gate. Each capture camp commandant keeps one in his locker.

LEVEL B (blue): the central building. Locked in the generator shed of every relay pylon.

LEVEL C (green): the lift to the lower laboratory. Kept by the chief researcher of each field laboratory.

Checkpoints hold NO cards. Lose yours and you join the specimens. - Security Office
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_final.page_0: FINAL ENTRY. So. They came through the gate, the hall, even my lift. Clever apes. I have always admired clever apes. I make them.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_final.page_1: Serum V-OMEGA is perfected: thrice the muscle, ten times the mind, and a temper I can only call magnificent. I have tested it on no one. Yet.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_final.page_2: If they corner me, I shall test it on myself - and greet them from the cockpit of the Walker in the Main Laboratory. Let science decide who is the better ape.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_final.page_3: To whoever reads this: you are about to witness the next step of evolution. Try not to scream. - Dr. A. Oinstein, Director

item.retrocosmos.ray_blaster.desc: Dr. Oinstein's ray pistol. Recharges between shots; repair with redstone.
Ah, a visitor! Do wipe your feet - this is a laboratory.
You came all this way to be disintegrated? How thoughtful.
Behold the Atomic Strider! Forty tons of pure progress!
Hold still! Science requires a steady target.
Every great mind was mocked. Then it built a death ray.
Your skull has such a modest capacity. I could fix that.
The tribes worship the sun. Soon they will worship ME.
Atomic power, my friend! Clean, safe and very, very loud!
Is that iron? How charmingly medieval.
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.doctor.serum: Very well. I was saving the last dose for a special occasion...
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.homo.awake: Magnificent... I can hear your thoughts. They are very small.
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.homo.taunt.1: Evolution is not a theory. It is ME!
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.homo.taunt.2: Your ancestors were apes. Your descendants will be MINE.
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.homo.taunt.3: So many thoughts! I can taste them!
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.homo.rage: Children! Out of your tanks - Father needs you!
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.kill.0: Another one for the specimen jars!
chat.retrocosmos.oinstein.kill.2: Note: the subject did not survive. Next!
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page0:
LAB JOURNAL, VENUS.

Day 1. The natives are hominids: stone tools, fire, painfully slow. Their skulls hold 900 cc. Mine holds 1600. The conclusion writes itself.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page1: Day 40. Serum batch 7 doubles muscle mass in a week. The subjects lose speech but gain obedience. The collars work. I call them Novus - the new.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page2: Day 112. Batch 9 swells the brain instead. Too big for the skull - a glass flask will do. Hominus Sapiens can aim a ray pistol. It can also hate. Noted.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page3: Day 200. Someone from Earth keeps freeing my specimens. One dose remains, the purest yet. In an emergency, inject into the neck. Do NOT exceed one dose.
book.retrocosmos.oinstein_notes.page4:
If you are reading this, I exceeded one dose.

Let the tribesfolk go home. Tell Earth the ape was never the problem. The man with the syringe was.

- O.

item.retrocosmos.ranger_star.lore.1: for courage beyond the call of duty
item.retrocosmos.serum_vigor.desc: Muscle in a syringe. You will be hungry afterwards.
item.retrocosmos.serum_swiftness.desc: Legs like a raptor's - for a while.
item.retrocosmos.serum_cerebral.desc: Brighter eyes, quicker hands, a spinning head.
item.retrocosmos.serum_regeneration.desc: Knits flesh in seconds. Leaves you ravenous.
item.retrocosmos.serum_hide.desc: Skin like a dinosaur's. Arms like jelly after.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.greet.2: Tribe give good thing. Sky-man give good thing.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.greet.3: Sky-man come in fire-bird! Tribe see!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.greet.4: No touch fire. Fire bite. Trade instead.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.greet.5: Clear ice-stone! Sky-man have clear ice-stone?
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.hunter.0: Hunter kill big lizard. You want tooth?
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.gatherer.0: Gatherer pick fern. Fern soft. Good for rope.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.gatherer.1: Glow-mushroom tea make eyes see in dark.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.shaman.0: Spirits say... sky-man come from star.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.shaman.1: Mask hold spirit. Charm hold spirit. Amber hold sun.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.chief.0: Chief speak! Sky-man trade fair, or tribe angry.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.chief.1: Chief want shiny metal. Chief give much amber.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.angry: Sky-man hurt tribe! Tribe hurt sky-man!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.mask: Sky-man wear tribe face! Sky-man friend! Good price!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.friend: Sky-man free tribe-brother from glass-head den! Friend price!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.0: Sky-man! Help! Bad white-coat man lock tribe in box!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.1: Ugh... no fire... no sky... want go home...
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.2: White-coat man make tribe-brother big and angry. Next is me!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.3: Psst! Sky-man! Bars too strong for tribe hands...
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.4: Glass-head come with needle every night. Ugh. Hurts.
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.5: Tribe hear iron-man walking. Clank, clank. Sky-man careful!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.6: Sky-man open box? Tribe give amber! Much amber!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.captive.locked: Box shut tight! Sky-man find way to open!
chat.retrocosmos.tribe.freed.1: Ugh! Sky-man strong friend! Take, take! Gift!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.0: Ah, a fellow explorer! Come in, come in - mind the crates.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.1: Found anything old, odd or obviously cursed? I pay in good Space Credits.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.2: Every relic tells a story, my friend. Let's hear yours.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.3: The Smithsonian would weep to see what I keep in this office.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.4: Back from Venus in one piece? Splendid. Show me the loot!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.greet.5: Rocket fuel, oxygen, tea - and a fair price for antiquities. Cooper's, at your service.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.0: Fascinating... the glyphs repeat every nineteen marks. A calendar? A warning?
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.1: Some day there'll be a museum of the Solar System. I intend to fill it.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.2: I once traded a pocket watch for a raptor tooth. Best deal of my career.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.3: Whoever built those Venusian pyramids knew their stars better than we do.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.4: Mind you don't touch the idol. It hums at night. I'm nearly sure it hums.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.idle.5: Hmm. Someone has been at my blueprints drawer... no, no, not ready yet.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.thanks.0: Splendid! Into the collection it goes.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.thanks.3: Handle that canister gently - it's not a souvenir.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.protest.0: I say! I'm a scholar, not a punching bag!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.protest.1: Steady on! I survived three curses and a camel - you won't be the end of me.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.protest.2: Careful! You'll knock over the Ming vase. Well - the Venusian equivalent.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.venusi: Great Scott - a Venusian idol! Look at the workmanship! Those eyes... they followed me. Did you see that?
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.glyph_: A glyph tablet! The first complete inscription I've ever held. Somebody fetch me a dictionary - from 10,000 B.C.!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.sun_di: A piece of a sun disk! Bring me every shard you find - I mean to put the whole thing back together.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.ancien: By Jove... an ancient amulet. It's warm. Why is it warm?! This changes everything we know about Venus!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.tribal: A tribal mask! Living culture, right next to the ruins - the tribes may be the builders' descendants!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.bone_s: A bone spear, flint-tipped and balanced like a rifle. Remarkable craftsmen, our hairy neighbours.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.raptor: A raptor tooth! Serrated like a steak knife. I'll keep this one on my desk - as a reminder to stay on the path.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.dino_h: Dinosaur hide! Tanned by hand, too. Wait until the boys at the University see this.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.venus_: Venusian amber - and there's something inside! A bug? A seed? Ha! A whole lost world in a pebble.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.shaman: A shaman's charm. I don't believe in magic, of course. ...Of course. Put it down gently.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.tyrann: Good heavens - a tyrant lizard's fang! As long as my hand! You... you didn't fight it, did you? Sit down. Have a drink.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.plesio: A sea-serpent's tooth! So the sailors' stories were true - out there in that boiling sea, something with a neck like a crane.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.deinos: Crocodile? No - something far worse. Look at the size of it! Stay away from the swamp banks, my friend.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.ankylo: Armour plate from a living tank! Our engineers would give their slide rules for an alloy this tough.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.contro: A control collar - riveted steel, a radio valve and a kill switch. Whoever built this wanted an army, not a pet. Oinstein...
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.brain_: Good Lord, it's still warm. A brain - an ape's brain, three times too big. I'll need a stiff drink and a bigger jar.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.atomic: Still warm! An atomic core from one of Oinstein's machines... Wrap it in lead, please, and never tell me where you got it.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.cooper.first.generi: Now THAT is something I've never seen before. Into the collection!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.0: Stay inside the perimeter, civilian. Raptors hunt in packs out there.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.2: Ray pistols, fresh charge, full safety. Don't worry, I'm a crack shot.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.3: The hairy fellows from the jungle? Friendly, long as you don't poke 'em.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.4: Saw a long-neck big as a gantry by the river this morning. Didn't even look at us.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.5: Nobody goes into those ruins without telling the sergeant. Doctor's orders - Cooper's, that is.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.6: If the triceratops lowers its head - run. Don't ask, just run.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.talk.7: Ever seen a sunset through Venus clouds? Copper and green. Beats Nebraska.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.idle.2: Hope the cook didn't put dinosaur in the stew again.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.idle.3: Keep your eyes peeled for movement in the ferns.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.idle.4: Battery at ninety percent. Ready for anything.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.alert.2: Hold it right there, you overgrown lizard!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.kill.0: Target down. Back to your posts.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.protest.0: Watch it, pal! I'm on your side!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.protest.1: Assaulting an officer of the Expedition? Not on my watch.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.protest.2: Save it for the raptors, mister.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.guard.protest.3: One more of those and you're on latrine duty.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.0: The ruins predate the tribes by thousands of years - yet the tribes guard them like temples.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.1: Raptors are pack hunters. Wound one and the whole pack comes. Remember that.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.2: Glowcap mushrooms brewed in water make a tea with remarkable effects on night vision.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.3: The tribesfolk adore anything shiny. Wear one of their masks and they'll treat you like kin.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.4: Fumaroles in the highlands vent sulphur. Fascinating chemistry. Terrible smell.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.5: The brontosaurus is a gentle giant - a plant eater. Just don't stand where it steps.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.6: Venus amber traps insects from a hundred million years ago. Dr. Cooper pays well for it.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.7: The glyphs on the pyramid steps match the star charts. They were watching the sky - watching Earth.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.8: A triceratops will charge anything that threatens its young. Give the calves a wide berth.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.9: Tar pits in the swamp preserve bones perfectly. Also unwary geologists.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.10: Oxygen readings are fine at ground level - but keep your suit handy in orbit.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.lore.11: Somewhere in the ruins there is a sealed chamber. The tablets call it 'the house of the sun'.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.idle.0: Sample forty-two: chlorophyll... but not as we know it.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.idle.1: Readings are off the charts! Literally - I need more chart paper.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.idle.2: Note to self: do NOT feed the raptors.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.idle.3: If only Professor Einstein could see this.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.idle.4: Humidity ninety-eight percent. My slide rule is warping.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.flee.2: Not the notes! Save the notes!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.protest.0: Ow! I'm a scientist, not a test subject!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.protest.1: Please! These instruments are delicate - and so am I.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.scientist.protest.2: I shall be noting this in my report.
chat.retrocosmos.npc.decorator.greet.0: Every modern family deserves a home of TOMORROW! Have a look around, dear!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.decorator.greet.1: Welcome to the Atomic Home Showroom! Space-age living at down-to-Earth prices!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.decorator.greet.2: Is that a bare steel cabin I see in your eyes? Let's fix that, sweetie!
chat.retrocosmos.npc.decorator.greet.3: Chrome! Turquoise! Boomerangs! Everything a rocket-age home could want!
